description:
ExpandFunctionSource and DefineFunction answer one question in two jobs:
"what is this function's definition". ExpandFunctionSource expands the
function's source (running macros) and publishes ExpandedFunctionSource;
DefineFunction reads it and publishes FunctionDefined. They always run back
to back on the same subject with nothing else scheduled between them.

Evidence (develop @ a41b6de3b):
- ExpandedFunctionSource has exactly one reader: DefineFunction's wait
  (jobs/source.rs:278-281, reads at :318-321). No other FactKey reader
  (grep src; the rest is producer arm drive.rs:672, rank drive.rs:365,
  telemetry jsonl.rs:2270/2492, and the unresolved-issue arm world.rs:2516).
- The expanded source is stored twice: in World's
  ExpandedFunctionSourceMap (world.rs:135, identity.rs:703) and again inside
  the function definition (identity.rs:245, world.rs:3239-3242).
- On `def main(), do: 1` (s1) both kinds run once per subject after
  fz-afu.2; the pair is 4 of the 28 predicted runs. Ledger:
  scratchpad wave2/r_s1_ledger/ledger.md.

Paper: DefineFunction does the expansion itself -- it waits on what
expansion waits on today (FunctionSource / the scope facts named by
demand_function_scope; the macro product reads through
FunctionSourceExpander's Blocked effects) and publishes FunctionDefined in
the same conclusion.

Removal ledger:
- Job::ExpandFunctionSource and its producer arm (drive.rs:672)
- FactKey::ExpandedFunctionSource (drive.rs:267, :317, :365; telemetry
  jsonl.rs:2270, :2492; world.rs:2516)
- ExpandedFunctionSourceMap and World::expanded_function_source /
  note_expanded_function_source (identity.rs:703, world.rs:135/271)
Survivor: DefineFunction, and the expanded source kept once, inside the
function definition.

Prediction: s1 28 -> 26 (one run per subject fewer). Every census pin that
counts ExpandFunctionSource or DefineFunction starts only drops; none rises.
Before building: count readers of the definition's expanded_source field
and confirm FunctionDefined's revision moves exactly when the expansion
changes today (a re-expansion that yields the same source must not bump
FunctionDefined).

Depends on fz-afu.2 (measure on top of gated starts).
Acceptance: s1 measured 26 runs / 26 subjects' worth minus the removed kind;
full gate green; pins only drop; docs that name ExpandFunctionSource
updated (grep .agent/).
title: ExpandFunctionSource folds into DefineFunction
